# row is the pre-edit version row template; - means no pre-existing version row, writes[] means each batch write.
# <part> is the member-list shard selected by the ordinary member algorithm, not an extra URL or environment input.
# revision is doc.rev|revision|rev. etag is true|false for the success header.
# if_match is optional|ignored|base-rev: the latter is optional If-Match with the existing mandatory base_rev fallback, P/08.0-R006.
# source is the exact four-cell English source table row as a strict JSON array. Multiple operation projections may share it.
